title: Claude's own limit list is read: the scoped weekly allowance holds and extra-usage spend shows
description: A stub usage answer carries Claude's limits[] — weekly at 40% beside a Fable-scoped weekly at 97% — and spend enabled. Through the real control plane, with the account's own live request passing, the Fable window holds the account with the reason 'Fable weekly allowance 97% used, back <time>', master registry shows the extra-usage line 'extra usage on: $X of $Y used', and Mainworks sends no request that changes spending.
